title: Changing generated Dockerfile steps requires updating the Dockerfile fixtures in tests/resources/dockerfile
answers: why do dockerfile tests fail after changing generate_dockerfile
add a RUN step to generated serving Dockerfile
body:
Symptom: Dockerfile generation tests fail after the generated output changes, even though the generator logic is correct.
Root cause: The tests compare output of mlflow/models/docker_utils.py:generate_dockerfile against static files in tests/resources/dockerfile (Dockerfile_default, Dockerfile_conda, Dockerfile_java_flavor, Dockerfile_sagemaker_*, etc.), so each generator change has to be mirrored in every fixture it affects.
Fix pattern: When a shared step string such as SETUP_APT_TIMEOUTS is added to generate_dockerfile, update all affected fixture files in the same change so the rendered text matches byte-for-byte, including the same RUN ordering and comment lines.
Constraints: Fixtures for custom base images are unaffected when the generator branch does not emit the step; check each fixture's FROM line to see which branch it exercises.
applies: Any change to the text emitted by generate_dockerfile in mlflow/models/docker_utils.py.
says: Add network timeout commands when building container images for serving deployed machine learning models.
Container build hangs downloading system packages while generating the deployment image for model serving.
Include package manager timeout settings in generated container build instructions for model deployment.
Insert extra installation steps into the container specification for serving trained machine learning models.
search: Modifying generated Dockerfile output in mlflow/models/docker_utils.py:generate_dockerfile requires updating matching static fixture files in tests/resources/dockerfile so that rendered text matches byte-for-byte. Any change to emitted text, such as adding a shared RUN step like SETUP_APT_TIMEOUTS, must be mirrored in affected fixtures including Dockerfile_default, Dockerfile_conda, Dockerfile_java_flavor, and Dockerfile_sagemaker_*. Fixtures for custom base images are unaffected when the generator branch does not emit the step, determined by each fixture's FROM line.
